content:ab17ef85246b1f80a31248a682c3dbe3.english_reader_card: A stolen van hit 100mph during a police chase through Bolton, Wigan and Chorley on Wednesday, injuring a cyclist and damaging street furniture. The pursuit ended when the van hit a stationary car at a pedestrian crossing.

english_fact_card.what_happened: A stolen van reached speeds of up to 100mph during a police pursuit through Bolton, Wigan and Chorley on Wednesday (August 14). The driver failed to stop at red lights, forced a pedestrian to run for safety, clipped a roundabout, and eventually mounted a pedestrian crossing and hit a stationary car. A cyclist was injured but not seriously. GMP received a 999 call at 6.23pm about a van containing parcels worth around £1,000 being stolen in Bolton. Officers located the van within 15 minutes, but the driver made off. The pursuit lasted 40 minutes and crossed into Lancashire.
english_fact_card.who_affected: Cyclist (minor injuries), pedestrian, other road users, police
english_fact_card.why_now: Police have released details of the dangerous pursuit and its outcome
